resolution_standard: For this pilot only, resolve the primary mechanism as state facilitation when post-cutoff official records identify concrete state-linked travel, transport or commercial facilitation and formally attribute the activity to political instrumentalisation. This is institutional resolution, not judicial proof.

outcome_sources.title: EU broadens sanctions scope to tackle hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants
outcome_sources.supports: The Council created designation criteria for people and entities organising or contributing to activities facilitating illegal border crossings.

outcome_sources.title: EU adopts fifth sanctions package over instrumentalisation of migrants
outcome_sources.supports: The Council named Belavia, tour operators and hotels as helping incite and organise illegal border crossings and participating in political instrumentalisation.

limitations: The outcome is an official institutional attribution and sanctions decision, not a criminal conviction or judicial finding.
The later outcome does not prove every pre-cutoff public allegation or disclose the full command chain.
The pilot scores whether the engine anticipated the predeclared institutional resolution standard, not metaphysical truth.
